reason: Expert shares a hardware compatibility rule for older transmission nodes and third-party SFPs.

knowledge.summary: Older transmission nodes reject third-party SFPs from the latest batch and keep the port down, so only approved part SFP-10G-LR-02 should be used on them.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Approved part number is SFP-10G-LR-02. Newer transmission nodes accept both.
